description: Czart, a Polish devil with shaggy black fur, two curved goat horns, goat legs with cloven hooves and a long thin tail with a tuft at its end, glowing red eyes and a wicked grin, lifting a huge grey boulder above his head with both hands, ready to throw it, menacing, full body, three-quarter view, the creature alone holding its boulder, no other rocks, no ground, no background, the whole creature and the whole boulder inside the picture
